ArchivePage.footer: When you restore it, a course goes back to the köşk page and the talebe’s course lists, a week or a session to the course’s programme, and a recording to its own session. Talebe do not see what is hidden; a hidden course’s weeks, sessions and recordings come back with the course.
ArchivePage.koskIntro: Courses, weeks, sessions, recordings and decks hidden in this köşk, and what was hidden in the medrese courses taught here. Nothing hidden is deleted; when you restore it, it goes back where it was.
ArchivePage.platformIntro: What was hidden in every köşk and medrese. You can restore it or delete it for good; a permanent delete cannot be undone and is written to the audit log.
ArchivePage.restoreLevel: You cannot bring this back: a higher level hid it, and only that level or one above can bring it back.
ArchivePage.restoreParentHidden: What it belongs to is still hidden; restore that first.
ArchivePage.title: Archive
Changes.note: Restore brings the hidden item back at once: a course to the köşk's page and the talebe's course lists, a week or a session to the course's programme, a deck to the köşk, where the talebe see it again. It asks for no confirmation, is written to the audit log with its level, and the item can be hidden again. Delete permanently is the Medaris başnazım's alone: the item and everything under it (weeks, sessions, the talebe's enrolments and progress, recordings, cards) go in one step, its files are removed from storage, and the session cancellations still owed are sent. It cannot be undone and is written to the audit log under your name.
HideLevel.locked: Hidden by {level}; only that level or one above can bring it back.
